title: The Farey tree and fibrations of the Whitehead link complement
summary: We show a curious connection between an example of dynamical forcing, where an existence of one periodic orbit for a dynamical system forces the existence of other periodic orbits, and the existence of different fibrations of a 3 dimensional manifold. Specifically, we establish a one to one correspondence between fibrations of the Whitehead link complement and the set of `simple orbit pairs' on the torus.
